version.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file from the repository.
- No functional or user-facing changes; only documentation maintenance.
- The core review flow and guidance remain unchanged.

llm.summary: This is a plain code-review guidance skill with no scripts, persistence, credential handling, or hidden execution behavior.

dimensions.detail: Reviewing diffs, callers, tests, and documentation is proportionate to a code-review skill, and no broad local indexing or sensitive account/profile access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of a single Markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata; no executable scripts, dependencies, installer hooks, or remote payload retrieval are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to user-requested reviews and explicitly end with 'Lists findings, changes no code.' No prompt hijacking, role override, exfiltration, or unrelated behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, background worker, scheduled task, memory write, or credential/session handling appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to guide quality review of code changes, and its instructions are limited to reading diffs and related code, identifying concrete issues, and reporting findings without changing code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a stricter code-review style focused on bugs, security, load, tests, speed, and deleting unnecessary code. It will encourage the agent to inspect relevant repository files for reviews, but the skill itself does not ask to modify files or run hidden code.
